item.title: Teatro di Locarno: more funding sought from public authorities
item.description: More than one hundred members at Thursday evening's assembly A deficit of approximately 55'000 francs in the 2025/26 season The shortfall was covered with the association's assets
item.content:encoded:
## TL;DR - More than one hundred members at the assembly on Thursday evening - Deficit of approximately 55'000 francs in the 2025/26 season - The deficit was covered with the association's assets - More support requested from public bodies
## Key facts - Place → Locarno city theatre - Association → Friends of the Theater of Locarno - Secretary → Athos Mecca - Deficit → approximately 55,000 francs - Accounting season → 2025/26 - Subscribers → over 400 - President → Diego Erba - Artistic director → Paolo Crivellaro
In Locarno, the annual meeting of the «Friends of the Theater of Locarno» Association brought together over one hundred members in the city theater on Thursday evening. The meeting was dedicated to the future of the prose seasons and the financial sustainability of the cultural offer in the Locarno area.
The secretary Athos Mecca opened the proceedings, presenting the accounts for the 2025/26 season. The picture that emerged was difficult especially due to the reduction in contributions from public bodies. To make up the deficit of around 55,000 francs, the association's social assets were drawn upon.
The data brought the continuity of the association's activity to the center of the meeting, which does not only concern the closing of the season's accounts but also the sustainability of the following years. Mecca summarized the prospect in clear words, warning that, if revenues continued to not cover costs, the association's activity could cease within a few years.
The reference to the financial sustainability of the cultural offering was thus linked to the discussion on the future of the prose seasons. The assembly found itself having to evaluate the stability of the association while the social assets were used to cover the negative result of the season.
During the meeting, the auditors Daniele Bianchetti and Gianni Gnesa were also reconfirmed. Their mandate was confirmed together with the continuation of the discussion on the financing of theatrical activity, which remained linked to the reduction of public contributions and the need to keep revenues in relation to costs.
The picture given to the members is therefore that of an association that covered the deficit of the 2025/26 season, but which considers the continuity of revenue a condition to avoid the interruption of the activity within a few years. The request for greater public support arises from the situation illustrated during the meeting in the city theater. ## The quality of the offering and possible future scenarios
Artistic director Paolo Crivellaro presented the new theatre season with the aid of images. In his address, he emphasized the high quality of the offering, a proposal greatly appreciated by the more than 400 subscribers and the audience.
After the artistic presentation, the discussion focused on the prospects for the programming of Teatro di Locarno. Diego Erba, president of the Associazione, recalled the economic difficulties that the organization has faced for years and asked public bodies to increase their support.
The appeal concerned the Fondazione per la cultura nel Locarnese and the Città, which owns the theatre. The discussion also considered the role of the other municipalities, called upon to assess the value of the theatre seasons for the region.
The possibilities examined during the assembly were several:
| Possibility | Content | |---|---| | Suspension of activities | Suspend activities | | Reduction in performances | Reduce the number of performances | | One evening per event | Go from two evenings to one | | Association's assets | Cover deficits |
These possibilities showed the various ways put on the table to address the shortage of funds. On the one hand, the possibility of scaling back the programming was considered, by changing the number of performances or the evenings scheduled for each event. On the other hand, recourse to the association's assets remained an option, having already been used to cover the season's deficit.
Many members emphasized the value of the theatre in the Locarnese and asked for public contributions to be strengthened. The assembly therefore unanimously approved a resolution addressed to the Fondazione per la cultura, the Città and the other municipalities.
The document calls on these bodies to ensure greater support and reaffirms the cultural value of the theatre seasons for the region. The vote gave a shared form to the request that emerged during the debate, alongside the presentation of the new season and confirmation of the appreciation expressed by the subscribers and the audience. ## The commitment for the coming seasons
The organizers have confirmed their commitment to ensuring the upcoming theater seasons. The Association indicated that, if necessary, it may use its assets to cover deficits and continue supporting its activities.
The announced decision aims to maintain the program despite the financial situation outlined during the assembly. The goal remains to offer quality performances with realistic, pluralistic and diverse storytelling, in accordance with the association’s statutes.
### Programming tied to the statutes
The organizers’ confirmation links the future of the seasons to the possibility of maintaining the association’s cultural commitment. The association’s assets are identified as a resource to be used if the finances make it necessary, while the artistic program remains focused on quality and variety in storytelling.
The message addressed to public institutions and the commitment undertaken internally by the Association therefore move in the same direction: supporting the continuation of the seasons and preserving the cultural value recognized in Teatro per il Locarnese. The confirmation concerns the upcoming seasons and leaves the association responsible for continuing to present performances according to the principles set out in its statutes.
As is tradition, the evening ended with the performance «Ostinata con brio» by Federica Molteni, presented to attendees and the local community and dedicated to Antonia Brico, the first woman to gain international recognition as an orchestra conductor.
The performance was warmly received. The meeting thus concluded by pairing the discussion of funding with a moment from the theater program, intended both for the assembly participants and the local community.

item.title: Emergency management: Extramuro closes between Ticino and Lombardy
item.description: The second edition of «Extramuro» ended in Erba About ten officers from Ticino attended the training across the border The program involves Ticino
item.content:encoded:
## TL;DR - The second edition of «Extramuro» concluded in Erba - Around ten Ticinese officers attended the training across the border - The program involves Ticino and Regione Lombardia - The simulations took place between Erba, Merone and Pusiano
## Key facts - Programme → «Extramuro» - Edition → 2026 - Ceremony venue → Erba Emergency Multipurpose Centre - First phase → 8 and 11 June - Second phase → 1 October in Pollegio, 5–9 October in Erba, Merone and Pusiano - Coordination → Directorate General for Security and Civil Protection of the Lombardy Region - Basis of cooperation → Italian-Swiss Convention of 2 May 1995
The second edition of «Extramuro», the joint training programme of the civil protection systems of the Canton of Ticino and the Lombardy Region, concluded in Erba (Como). Cross-border cooperation aims to ensure a rapid and coordinated response in shared emergencies.
In June, in Pollegio, Ticino had hosted around seventy Lombardy officers, officials and commanders; it subsequently sent around ten civil protection officers in training across the border. The ceremony took place on Friday, 9 October at the Erba Emergency Multipurpose Centre, in the presence of representatives of the Lombardy and Ticino authorities and of the organisations that collaborated on the initiative.
### Two phases, from training to simulations
On 8 and 11 June, at the Cantonal Civil Protection Training Centre in Pollegio, the Military and Civil Protection Section (SMPP) provided Lombardy officials and commanders with training based on the Ticino model for managing major emergencies.
The second phase began on 1 October in Pollegio and, from 5 to 9 October, included training activities and field simulations in Erba, Merone and Pusiano. Coordination was entrusted to the Directorate General for Security and Civil Protection of the Lombardy Region, alongside the Fire Brigade, AREU Lombardia, the Province of Como and the Chiasso Police and Customs Cooperation Centre.
For a cross-border commuter, the picture above all shows the territorial dimension of crisis management: procedures, operating methods and response systems are compared when an emergency makes it necessary to activate the mutual assistance provided for by the agreements between Italy and Switzerland. To locate the places mentioned, mappa dei valichi is available.
> Norman Gobbi, State Councillor and head of the Department of Institutions, stressed that dealing with emergencies requires people who know one another and have already worked together. ## The practical value of reciprocity
For those who work or live between the Canton of Ticino and Regione Lombardia, the most tangible element of the initiative is the mutual understanding built before the emergency. The source identifies three levels of work: procedures, operational methods and intervention systems. It is therefore not merely a matter of presenting two models, but of strengthening the ability to work together when an emergency requires activation of the mutual assistance provided for in the agreements between Italy and Switzerland.
The 2026 training therefore forms part of a relationship that, according to the source, already has an operational and institutional history.
The source recalls two instances. The first dates back to the migrant crisis in Como in the summer of 2016; the second concerns the forest fire on Monte Gambarogno in January 2022. These are different precedents, but they are cited to show that cooperation has already found concrete application in emergency situations.
The training program has a precedent: in 2024, in Erba, the pilot course had brought a contingent of future company commanders from Ticino civil protection together with their Lombard counterparts; the 2026 edition continues that experience. From that point on, according to the source, the exchange became reciprocal: Ticino first welcomed Lombard officials and officers, then sent its own officers across the border for training.
For a cross-border commuter, the point to bear in mind is continuity: if an event affects the territory of the two countries, the response is not described as an isolated intervention, but as a system based on shared knowledge and existing agreements. 1. Identify the scope. The program connects the civil protection system of the Canton of Ticino with that of the Lombardy Region. item.title: 82 kilograms of meat and 492 bottles: customs fines
item.description: In Vacallo, 82 kilos of undeclared meat found In Stabio, 492 bottles of wine found The inspections took place on October 3 and 7 Fines and customs clearance
item.content:encoded:
## TL;DR - In Vacallo, 82 kilograms of undeclared meat were found - In Stabio, 492 bottles of wine were found - The checks took place on October 3 and 7 - Fines and customs clearance in both cases
## Key facts - Locations: Vacallo and Stabio - Dates: October 3 and 7 - Meat: 82 kilos - Wine: 492 bottles in 86 cartons - Outcome: fines and customs clearance
On October 3, in Vacallo, a mobile check on entry into the country led to the stopping of a vehicle with Swiss plates. Three Romanian citizens were traveling aboard. Employees of the Federal Office for Customs and Border Security discovered 82 kilos of meat intended for personal consumption and being transported to inland Switzerland. The goods had not been properly declared at the border.
### The first incident The occupants were offered the possibility of clearing the goods through customs. However, they preferred to leave Swiss territory again, in accordance with the applicable procedures. The failure to declare nevertheless resulted in a fine.
A few hours later, the same vehicle was stopped again in Switzerland. Since the meat was already on Swiss territory, in addition to a new penalty, it had to be cleared through customs.
### The check in Stabio On October 7, in Stabio, a mobile check led to the stopping of a van with Swiss plates, driven by a Swiss citizen returning from Italy. Inside, officers found 86 cartons containing a total of 492 bottles of wine, which had not been declared when crossing the border.
The driver explained that the wine had been purchased in Italy for a private party in inland Switzerland, where he lives. The failure to declare resulted in a fine and customs clearance of the goods.
The two incidents were detected in the Mendrisiotto by employees of the UDSC. The first involved meat intended for private use and two stops, with departure from the territory followed by a subsequent internal check. The second concerned wine purchased in Italy, a check upon return and the need to clear the load through customs. In both cases, the issue was the failure to declare the goods at the border. ### The practical takeaway for those crossing The two incidents make it possible to isolate a concrete point for those crossing the border with food or wine: the private use indicated by the people involved did not prevent a fine when the goods had not been declared. The meat was intended for private use; the wine had been purchased for a private party in inland Switzerland. In both cases, the personal destination did not settle the customs issue.
Neither the license plates nor residence ruled out the check. In the first incident, the vehicle had Swiss license plates and was carrying three Romanian citizens; in the second, the van had Swiss license plates and was driven by a Swiss citizen residing in inland Switzerland. The practical point, for a cross-border commuter, is that the check described by the source concerns the goods being transported and their declaration at the crossing.
| Incident | Goods | Element identified | Outcome | |---|---|---|---| | Vacallo | 82 kilograms of meat | Private use and failure to declare | Fine, followed by another penalty and customs clearance | | Stabio | 492 bottles in 86 cartons | Purchase in Italy and failure to declare | Fine and customs clearance |
The difference between the two cases lies in the sequence, not in the administrative outcome. In Vacallo, the occupants were able to leave Swiss territory, but the subsequent stop required customs clearance for the meat already present in Switzerland. In Stabio, by contrast, the driver had to regularize the load after the check. The reader who needs to organize a crossing can consult the page on tempi di attesa ai valichi alongside this information, without confusing it with the customs procedure described in the two incidents.

## Useful tools to protect your net income To reduce FX leakage, compare CHF-EUR exchange options and banks for cross-border workers. ### The procedure reconstructed from the checks For anyone who has to cross the border with foodstuffs, the sequence to bear in mind based on the two cases is straightforward.
1. When crossing the border, the goods must be declared. In the two incidents, meat and wine had been brought in without a proper declaration. 2. If the possibility of clearing the goods through customs is offered, the source shows that this option can be chosen: in Vacallo, the occupants were given the opportunity to proceed, but they preferred to leave Swiss territory. 3. Leaving did not cancel the fine. A few hours later, the same vehicle was stopped inside Switzerland, and the meat, already in the country, had to be cleared through customs along with a new penalty. 4. When the inspection concerns an undeclared load still present on the vehicle, the outcome described includes a fine and customs clearance. That is what happened in Stabio with the van returning from Italy.
For a cross-border commuter, the point to apply to their own crossing is therefore limited to the goods being transported and the declaration at the border. The case also shows that a mobile inspection can take place on entry, as in Vacallo and Stabio, or inside Switzerland, as in the second stop in the first incident.

item.description: Upriver Operation: seven arrests One of the arrests in the Varese area More than 100mila files seized Investigation coordinated by the Milan Prosecutor's Office Operation →
item.content:encoded:
## TL;DR - Upriver operation: seven arrests - One of the arrests in the Varese area - More than 100 thousand files seized - Investigation coordinated by the Milan Public Prosecutor's Office
## Key facts - Operation → Upriver - Objective → possession and online exchange of child pornography material - Arrests → seven - Complaints → seven - Files seized → over 100 thousand - Devices seized → approximately thirty - Data volume → over 26 thousand gigabytes - Start of investigation → 2025
Seven people were arrested red-handed during the State Police's Upriver operation, aimed at combating the detention and online exchange of child pornography material. The investigation also involved the province of Varese: one of those arrested lives in the Varese area.
Launched in 2025 in the framework of international police cooperation, the investigation was directed by the Milan Public Prosecutor's Office and by the Milan Cyber ​​Security Operations Center engaged in the activities, under the coordination of the National Center for combating online child pornography.
### The involvement of Varesotto
The investigators followed the online channels used to circulate the illicit material, identifying some accounts from which images and videos had been shared and downloaded. The searches carried out subsequently led to the flagrant arrests.
The investigative sequence connects the activity carried out online to the interventions carried out in the area: first the monitoring of channels and accounts, then the searches and arrests. For the Varese area, the element indicated is the local residence of one of the people involved in the operation.
The investigation did not cover just one territory. Its management by the Milanese bodies and the coordination of the national center are part of an activity that has affected several Italian areas, keeping the detention and online exchange of illicit material at the centre. The activities described do not end in the province of Varese: the execution of the arrests involved other territories, while the common point remains the use of online channels to share and download images and videos. ## Arrests, reports and seizures
### The geographical distribution
The arrested individuals are between 38 and 78 years old. Two arrests were carried out in the province of Milan and two in that of Bergamo. One arrest concerns the Varese area, one the Vicenza area and one in Florence. The distribution indicates the areas reached by Operation Upriver, which involved several areas of Italy.
In addition to the seven arrested people, another seven people were reported. The overall picture indicated in the investigation is therefore fourteen people involved, including those arrested and those reported. The distinction between the two groups is the one reported in the operation: seven arrests in the act and seven reports.
### The seizure figures
The seizure involved more than 100 thousand files, including images and videos, as well as approximately thirty digital devices: smartphones, tablets, computers and hard drives.
The total volume of the seized data exceeds 26 thousand gigabytes. This figure supplements the data on the files and digital devices seized and conveys the scale of the operation carried out by investigators on the monitored online channels.
The quantitative tally thus complements the geographical distribution of the arrests. On one side are the people identified in the provinces and territories indicated by the operation; on the other, the digital material collected during the searches. The Varese area appears in the geography of the arrests, while the numbers of files, devices and gigabytes concern the entire Upriver operation.
The sequence of data describes an investigation that resulted both in measures against individuals, with arrests and reports, and in seizures of digital material. On September 30, the TROTTA summer operation concluded in Ticino, a campaign of checks on soft mobility organized by the cantonal police together with the municipal police forces. The checks covered e-bikes and electric scooters, with the aim of verifying the vehicles’ compliance and users’ adherence to the rules.
The patrols worked for eight days at 11 strategic checkpoints distributed across Mendrisiotto, Luganese, Locarnese and Bellinzonese. The areas mentioned cover the main population centers in the region affected by the operation. Alongside enforcement, officers handed out informational material and provided practical advice to people stopped in high-traffic areas.
### The tally of violations
The checks concluded with 35 violations. In 15 cases, the seriousness of the infractions led to further legal proceedings: 13 reports were forwarded to the Juvenile Magistrate’s Office and two formal complaints to the Public Prosecutor’s Office.
For the technical checks, a special roller test bench was used directly on site. The measurements revealed irregularities in speed and construction characteristics in nine vehicles. Five vehicles had been tampered with by their drivers to increase performance; four others did not comply with the traffic requirements in force in Switzerland.
Among the non-compliant vehicles, e-bikes with power outputs between 1'200 and 1'600 watts were identified, exceeding the legal limit of 1'000 watts. The highest speed measured was 48 km/h. In this case, the driver was reported to the Public Prosecutor’s Office.

## TL;DR - Villa Sassa and Villa Principe Leopoldo closed for four months - Approximately 140 employees are out of work - Winter alternatives in St. Moritz, in the Engadine and in Cademario - Reopening in May, but gradually
## Key facts - Closing → four months - Staff involved → approximately 140 employees - Manager → Dot Life SA - Consultation → ends October 9th - Reopening → next May, gradual - Investments → over 40 million for Villa Sassa and over 12 million for Villa Principe Leopoldo - Work → two-three years
Villa Sassa and Villa Principe Leopoldo, in Lugano, will be closed for four months due to major renovation works. The consequence affects approximately 140 employees, who will remain without work during the closure period.
The company Dot Life SA, which manages the two hotels in Lugano, offers for the winter season the possibility of working in accommodation facilities in the St. Moritz region, in the Engadine, or at the Kurhaus in Cademario, which belongs to the same group. The consultation will end on 9 October; Daniele Lardi, president of Dot Life SA, specified that only later will the options be examined and how to proceed established.
> «We are making various opportunities available and, at the end of the consultation, set for 9 October (ed), we will examine the alternatives to decide how to proceed».
### A closure chosen after two years of preparation
The project required two years of preparation, during which multiple alternatives were evaluated, including a suspension of activity for two or three years. Finally, a four-month closure was opted for, considered the most appropriate solution to limit the duration of the interruption and avoid losing the workforce in the future.
However, closure is inevitable because the interventions are very invasive. The program includes heating and cooling systems, common areas, kitchens to be completely redone, restaurants and receptions. With works of this type, Lardi explained, a hotel facility cannot continue to operate.
### Gradual reopening and position of the unions
The reopening is scheduled for next May, but will proceed gradually. The works will in fact continue for two or three years and the staff will not be resumed immediately with all the staff. Trade unions have not yet been involved in the consultation; a meeting is scheduled for the next few weeks.
Luca Robertini of the OCST defined the situation as not rosy and dramatic in terms of its human impact. However, he noted that these are not 140 jobs destined to disappear from the canton: behind the restructuring there is a multi-million dollar investment which suggests a future guarantee, at least in part, for those positions. ## What changes for those who work in the two structures
For the cross-border worker who follows the Lugano job market, the practical point is to distinguish a temporary proposal from an already definitive decision. The sequence described by the company, however, is clear: first there is the consultation, then the evaluation of the possibilities and finally the decision on what to do. The opportunities indicated for the winter season are at facilities in the St. Moritz region, in the Engadine, or at the Kurhaus in Cademario. The text does not attribute a precise duration, salary or contractual conditions to the proposals. Presenting them as transfers already assigned would mean going beyond the source.

For staff, the reopening therefore does not coincide with the immediate return of all staff. The company has already indicated that it will proceed in stages. This element matters more than a simple date on the calendar, because it describes a prolonged transition phase: the structure reopens, but the completion of the interventions extends over time.
The OCST evaluation introduces a second element. On Sunday, October 11, Fabio De Luigi will officially open the 2026/27 season of the Teatro INTRED in Varese. De Luigi will be the protagonist of BIOL | In flesh and bones tour, the event chosen to raise the curtain on the new calendar of the Varese room.

A week later, on Saturday 17 October, Teatro INTRED will change registers with Gianluca Gotto and Question of Karma. Gotto is described as a writer, traveler and disseminator. item.title: Cardano al Campo: minor arrested with hashish
item.description: Stopped in Cardano al Campo a minor on a scooter He had seven doses of hashish, for just over 11 grams At home found another 88.3 grams of hashish
item.content:encoded:
## TL;DR - Stopped in Cardano al Campo by a minor on a scooter - It had seven doses of hashish, for just over 11 grams - Another 88.3 grams of hashish found at home - The boy was taken to Beccaria in Milan
## Key facts - Place → Cardano al Campo, on the border with Gallarate - Control → Gallarate Carabinieri checkpoint - Search → seven wrappers, just over 11 grams - Seizure from home → another 88.3 grams of hashish - Total → about one hundred grams of hashish - Destination → Cesare Beccaria Penal Institute for Juveniles in Milan
### Control on the road
An ordinary road check, carried out by the Carabinieri of the Operational and Radiomobile Unit of the Gallarate Company during a checkpoint in a peripheral road of Cardano al Campo, on the border with Gallarate, ended with the arrest of the Italian minor, already known to the police.
The boy was traveling on a scooter when the soldiers stopped him. During the personal search, seven packages containing hashish were found, with a total weight of just over 11 grams. The substance had already been divided into doses which, according to the police, were intended for sale.
The first segment of the story is therefore linked to a road traffic check and the search of the arrested young man. The discovery occurred on the minor's person, while the check was taking place on a peripheral road in the locality, indicated in the report as close to the border with Gallarate.
The arrest was carried out by the Carabinieri of the Gallarate Company through the Operations and Radiomobile Unit. The minor is accused of possession of narcotic substances for the purpose of trafficking. The reported dispute therefore concerns both the substance found during the checkpoint and the way in which, according to the military, the doses were prepared.
The stop on the scooter represented the beginning of the checks described in the news. After the on-site search, the police continued their activity in the boy's home, where other items and a further quantity of hashish were found. ## The search of the house
The discovery of the seven doses moved the checks from the street to the boy's home. After the stop and search, the military carried out a search in the minor's house. Here they found and seized another 88.3 grams of hashish, a different quantity from that found on the young man during the checkpoint.
### The seized items
| Object or element | Description reported | |---|---| | Hashish | Another 88.3 grams | | Knife | Switchblade, with residue on the blade | | Balance sheet | Precision | | Material | To package doses | | Notebook | Accounting of the drug dealing, according to investigators | | Smartphones | The young man would have used it for contacts with buyers |
The knife seized is described as a switchblade. On the blade, the police found residues of narcotic substance. A precision scale was also seized from the same house, together with the material used to package the doses.
Among the items collected there are also a notebook and a smartphone. For the notebook, the report attributes to the investigators the hypothesis that it contained the drug dealing accounts. As for the telephone, however, it is reported that the young man would have used it to maintain contact with buyers.
The house search therefore added other objects indicated in the seizure to the quantity of hashish found during the roadside check. The list includes the substance, the knife with residue on the blade, the scale, the packaging material, the notebook and the smartphone.
In the overall balance indicated by the police, approximately one hundred grams of hashish were seized. The data brings together the little more than 11 grams found on the minor and the 88.3 grams found in his home, as reported in the report of the intervention. ## After the formalities
### The destination of the minor
After the formalities, the minor was transferred to the Juvenile Penal Institute 'Cesare Beccaria' in Milan, at the disposal of the Juvenile Judicial Authority.
The Milan destination is indicated at the end of the sequence described by the carabinieri. Before that there had been a roadblock on a road on the outskirts of Cardano al Campo, the detention of the youth who was traveling on a scooter and the search with the finding of seven hashish packages. Subsequently, the checks moved to the residence, where the other 88.3 grams and the material listed in the report were seized.
The transfer to Beccaria is therefore the operational follow‑up referred to after those checks and after the formalities. The indicated institute is located in Milan, while the check that gave rise to the intervention took place in Cardano al Campo, on the border with Gallarate.
The news also links this passage to the minor’s judicial position: the boy is at the disposal of the Juvenile Judicial Authority. The accusation reported by the carabinieri is possession of narcotics for the purpose of trafficking, the same charge referred to in the arrest carried out at Cardano al Campo.
The report ends with the indication of the Juvenile Penal Institute 'Cesare Beccaria' in Milan as the boy’s destination after the formalities. No further steps beyond the transfer and the placement at the disposal of the juvenile judicial authority are reported.

item.title: Como, rejected the school plan of the mayor of Rapinese
item.description: The Provincial Council rejects the Municipality's proposal of Como.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - The Provincial Council rejects the proposal from the Municipality of Como. - Alessandro Rapinese votes against, connected via streaming. - The meeting is held at Villa Gallia. - The proposal fails to reach an agreement with the schools.
## Key facts - Body: Provincial Council - Proposer: Municipality of Como - Connected Mayor: Alessandro Rapinese - Location: Villa Gallia - Cited regional regulation: DGR no. XII/6621 of 27.07.2026
### The decision at Villa Gallia
The Provincial Council has rejected the proposal for the rationalization of Comprehensive Institutes put forward by the Municipality of Como. The proposed resolution received favorable votes from all others, while the Mayor of Como, Alessandro Rapinese, connected via streaming during tonight's meeting at Villa Gallia, voted against it.
The reason stated in the document is linked to the lack of elements required by the legislation and regional guidelines. The point mentioned with the greatest clarity concerns the agreement with the schools, which, according to the Provincial Council, has not been reached in the terms required by DGR no. XII/6621 of 27.07.2026.
The institutes involved, as read in the voted proposal, had reiterated that they were ready to dialogue with the municipal administration to jointly define the reorganization interventions for the city's school network. At the same time, they had formally expressed a reasoned dissent regarding the proposed solutions. The provincial document emphasizes that the municipal deliberation does not account for that dissent.
The reasons listed during the meeting are therefore based on the regional regulatory framework regarding schools. The evaluation also concerns the positions formally expressed by the involved institutes and the way these positions were reported in the municipal deliberation. The rejection thus concerns the proposal presented by the Municipality, for reasons linked to regional legislation and the required agreements with the schools. ### The objections collected in the document
The provincial decision first recalls the contrary report of the school leaders of the IC Como Borgovico and the IC Como Nord. The document also mentions the communications of the presidents of numerous city councils, in addition to that of the plexus contact person of the mother in via Zezio.
To these findings is added the note by Imerio Chiappa, director of the Territorial School Office, also referred to in the text as a former Provveditorate. His position concerns the hypotheses of closure or displacement of the plexuses, especially when the current school population still allows the formation of classes and sections and when an understanding with schools is lacking.
> According to Imerio Chiappa, the closure or movement of plexuses still able, based on the current school population, to easily form classes and sections is not acceptable if there is no agreement with the schools.
According to the note, such a decision would have significant social consequences for entire neighborhoods, which would remain without the service delivery points. Chiappa also recalled the absence of guarantees on the adequacy of the spaces and the fact that the proposal still insists on the same locations subject to administrative litigation.
The project of the Municipality aimed to increase the number of citizen Comprehensive Institutes from 8 to 5. It also included the closure of the Carluccio kindergarten in Via Volta and the primary Corridoni kindergarten in Via Sinigaglia, as well as the reopening of the maternal kindergarten in Ponte Chiasso. Thelatter was supposed to welcome the children of the Monte Olimpino kindergarten, whose renovation was never started. The closure of the Ponte Chiasso maternal had been strongly desired by the Rapinese administration only three years ago.
The project was contested by the opposition, teachers and families. Appeals and letters had triggered a mobilization in the courtyard of Palazzo Cernezzi during the session of the City Council. Despite those objections, the document had passed thanks to a compact majority, with the abstention of three councillors. The transition to the Region
Now the decisive transition falls to the Region. By the end of the year the final decision on the plan must be reached, but before the definitive provision the dialogue with the Municipality will also be reopened. This discussion must allow the administration, if it wishes, to make the requested changes.
The document of the Provincial Council, however, points out other still open elements. For the Cappuccini kindergarten and the Corridoni primary school, an evaluation is underway by the State Council. The situation of these two institutions is therefore considered together with the rest of the administrative process regarding the restructuring of the city schools.
For the changes concerning the other comprehensive institutions based in the Municipality of Como, the deliberations of all the involved Municipalities are still missing. In the case of relocations or closures of school sites, the document also calls for the need for agreements with the schools. These are the steps that will have to be addressed in the discussion following the provincial rejection.
The outcome will therefore depend on the path that will develop between the Region and the Municipality within the deadlines of the regional school sizing plan. The source already indicates the consequence in case an agreement is not reached: for the next school year the institutions would retain the current configuration.
The decision of the Provincial Council therefore does not introduce a new organization of the schools, but returns the municipal project to the discussion with the institutions, with the interested Municipalities and with the Region. The next provision must take into account the requested changes and the evaluations still underway.

### The return of the event
From October 10 to November 15, 2026, Ferrovia Vigezzina-Centovalli brings back Treno del Foliage, one of the most eagerly awaited autumn events. The panoramic journey takes place between Locarno, in Switzerland, and Domodossola, in Piedmont, taking passengers through Alpine landscapes lit up by the season’s warm colors.
Among the features highlighted for the journey are enchanted forests, deep gorges, spectacular bridges, historic villages and Alpine landscapes. These scenes accompany passengers along the route and are linked to the warm colors of autumn.
The historic railway line connects Canton Ticino to Piedmont and passes through the wild Centovalli and the very green Vigezzo Valley. Centovalli is described as wild, while Vigezzo Valley is described as very green; the route passes through both.
With a distance of 52 kilometers and a duration of just under two hours each way, the journey offers a panoramic itinerary along the historic line. Treno del Foliage is presented as an experience to be savored slowly, amid landscapes, villages and historic railway.
The return of the event thus brings back to the route between Italy and Switzerland a journey dedicated to the colors of the season, the places it passes through and the discovery of the area along Ferrovia Vigezzina-Centovalli. ## The line and international recognition
The route is 52 kilometers long and takes just under two hours each way. The route runs along a historic railway line linking Canton Ticino with Piedmont and crossing the Centovalli and Vigezzo Valley.
The two valleys represent a central part of the journey. Centovalli is described as wild, while Vigezzo Valley is lush green. The route also includes enchanted forests, deep gorges, spectacular bridges, historic villages and Alpine landscapes. In autumn, these places are lit up by the warm colors of the season and accompany the panoramic journey.
### A classic born in 2016
Since 2016, the Treno del Foliage has attracted visitors from all over the world and has become established as a classic of the autumn season. Ferrovia Vigezzina-Centovalli presents it again among the season’s most eagerly awaited experiences.
The route also has significance beyond national borders: Lonely Planet and the New York Times included it among the 10 most beautiful train journeys in the world. The recognition concerns the route between Italy and Switzerland and its combination of historic railway, Alpine landscape and villages.
The duration of just under two hours each way accompanies an itinerary that crosses different environments without separating the railway line from the territories encountered along the route. Ferrovia Vigezzina-Centovalli is thus presented through its historical, scenic and international dimensions. ## Departures and statements from FART
For the 2026 season, passengers have two options for starting the journey: Locarno or Domodossola. The formula also includes an intermediate stop along the route, to be made on the outbound or return journey. The stop is intended to explore the villages along the line.
The possibility of stopping along the route adds the discovery of the places passed through to the journey. The source indicates a stop on the outbound or return journey, while retaining Locarno and Domodossola as alternative starting points.
### FART’s comment
Commenting on the significance of the Treno del Foliage is Claudio Blotti, director of FART, the Ferrovie Autolinee Regionali Ticinesi.
> «Over time, the Treno del Foliage has established itself among the symbols of Ferrovia Vigezzina-Centovalli. Its route shows how a train journey can go beyond simple transfer, bringing together landscape, slowness, territory and discovery along a unique line».
Blotti also points to FART’s goal of continuing to promote the railway during the Foliage period and throughout the year. The goal includes new onboard experiences and promoting destinations along the line. The 2026 season thus combines flexible departure, an intermediate stop and attention to the villages along the route.

item.description: October 21 at 10 at the SOMS Hall in Brusimpiano On stage “The Water Queen” with Gli Alcuni Andersen’s fairy tale is about water conservation Earth
item.content:encoded:
## TL;DR - October 21 at 10 a.m. at the SOMS Hall in Brusimpiano - «The Queen of Water» on stage with Gli Alcuni - Andersen's fairy tale is about water conservation - Terra e Laghi celebrates twenty years of activity
## Key facts - What → «The queen of water» - When → Wednesday 21 October, 10:00 am - Where → SOMS Salon in Brusimpiano - Company → The Some (TV) - Interpreters → Tullia Dalle Carbonare and Simone Babetto - Direction → Sergio Manfio and Laura Fintina - Text → Sergio Manfio - Theme → water saving and conscious use
On Wednesday 21 October, at 10:00, the SOMS Show – Brusimpiano Mutual Aid Society – hosts the show «The queen of water». It is the stage with which the journey of Terra e Laghi Festival arrives in Brusimpiano, bringing to the stage a proposal aimed at children and entrusted to the prestigious Compagnia Gli Poco (TV).
The adventure is presented as colourful, dynamic, educational and filled with pure fantasy. On stage there are Tullia Dalle Carbonare and Simone Babetto. The direction is signed by Sergio Manfio and Laura Fintina, while the text is by Sergio Manfio. These are the artistic elements indicated for the show included in the festival program.
### A story to talk about water
The representation reinterprets Andersen's famous fairy tale and brings it towards a theme linked to everyday life: saving water and its conscious use. The theme is addressed in a delicate and engaging way, maintaining the link with the fantastic register of the narrative. The fairy tale thus becomes the starting point for talking about the environment through theatre.
The source indicates that children are a particularly attentive and receptive audience towards environmental issues. For this reason, narration is also an opportunity to transmit a strong and current educational message with immediate and evocative language. Theatrical language is used to combine imagination and environmental sensitivity, without giving up the educational dimension of the show.
The choice is brought back to the municipal administration of Brusimpiano. Thanks are addressed to the entire Administration and, in particular, to the Mayor Fabio Zucconelli and to the Councilor for Culture Bruno Ussia. The decision to bring «The queen of water» to Brusimpiano is presented as an investment, through art, in the education and sensitivity of the new generations. ## A festival spanning the Insubric area
Brusimpiano is part of Terra e Laghi's circuit, a traveling theater festival active in the Insubric area. The project connects municipalities in Lombardy, Piedmont, the Canton of Ticino and the Alpine Macroregion, also including the area's smallest villages in its itinerary.
### From ten municipalities to an international network
Launched with ten municipalities in Insubria, the festival has become an international network that now involves more than one hundred public and private entities. Its development rests on coordination among local administrations, institutions and cultural associations, through which theater spreads throughout the area and reaches even the smallest villages.
Artistic director Silvia Priori linked the festival's twenty years to encounters, shared experiences, emotions and the relationship between art and the territory.
Silvia Priori described the twentieth anniversary as a tribute to twenty years of history, encounters, sharing and strong emotions, together with the art, theater and territory that welcome them.
Priori described an area that may lie on the margins, on the border, often considered a dormitory area or forgotten, and explained that Terra e Laghi has transformed geography into dramaturgy. In this reading, boundaries are not barriers but possibilities, distances become encounters, the outskirts harbor the most urgent need for community, and the spark of possibility is kindled in forgotten places.
Francesca Caruso highlighted the work carried out over twenty years to connect municipalities, institutional networks and associations in Lombardy, Switzerland and other European territories. In her view, the festival is among the most extensive and significant in the Alpine area and represents a source of pride and a way to promote our land. item.description: A Porlezza tentata truffa del finto carabiniere
item.content:encoded:
## TL;DR
- In Porlezza, attempted scam by a fake Carabinieri officer - The phone call dates back to October 7, 2026 - Gold requested to secure the son's release - The son's return foiled the plan
## Key facts
- Location → Porlezza - When → Wednesday, October 7, 2026 - Method → fake phone call from a Carabinieri officer - Request → gold and valuables kept at home - Emergency → son supposedly arrested - Report → Single Emergency Number 112 - Response → Carabinieri officers from the Menaggio Company
On the morning of Wednesday, October 7, 2026, an elderly woman living in Porlezza received a phone call designed to cause fear and obtain the immediate handover of money or valuables. The man on the other end introduced himself as a Carabinieri officer.
The criminal reported a false emergency: according to the story told over the phone, the woman's son had been arrested. To secure his release, the victim would have to urgently hand over all the gold in the home. The request therefore concerned the valuables kept in the house and played on the need to act quickly.
The plan did not succeed, however. While the woman was still engaged in the conversation, her son returned home and immediately noticed his mother's agitated state. He realized that something was wrong and intervened directly in the phone call.
### The moment of discovery
At that point, the scammer realized he had been found out and abruptly ended the call. The son's intervention therefore stopped the request before the gold or other valuables could be handed over.
The entire incident revolved around the false news of the arrest and the promise of securing the family member's release in exchange for valuable goods. The elderly woman did not have a chance to hand over what was requested, because her son's return made it possible to immediately recognize the anomaly in the phone call and stop the attempt. ## The request for gold is a warning sign
### Fear as leverage
The case fits a scam pattern that primarily targets older people: exploiting anxiety about what will happen to a family member, the scammer pretends to be a law enforcement officer and creates such a sense of urgency that it prompts the victim to act before being able to verify what they are told.
In the case of Porlezza, the false emergency was linked to the alleged detention of the son. The requested handover directly concerned the gold and valuables kept at home, on the grounds that they were needed to secure the family member's release. The request for valuables thus becomes the central step in the scam: fear is used to make a decision urgent when it should instead be verified.
The Carabinieri once again urge people to treat requests made by phone or in person for money, jewelry, or other valuables as suspicious. As law enforcement agencies remind us, no one asks for payments, bail, or valuables to avoid an arrest or secure a family member's release.
This warning therefore also applies to requests made with an apparent official justification. The fact that the caller presents themselves as a military officer does not change the rule indicated by the Carabinieri: money or valuables must not be handed over based on a request received in a situation designed to cause alarm.
If you receive a similar call, hang up immediately and call 112. Do not hand over money or valuables or follow the supposed officer's instructions. In the case of Porlezza, it was precisely the son's intervention that prevented the valuables kept in the home from being handed over. ## The investigations following the report
### The call to 112
Once the call had ended, the son informed the Single Emergency Number 112 of what had happened. Shortly afterwards, the officers of the Compagnia di Menaggio reached the home in a patrol car and began investigating the case.
The subsequent operational developments indicated for the incident therefore concern the report made to the emergency control room and the checks initiated by the officers who intervened in Porlezza. The call to 112 came after the criminal had abruptly ended the conversation, realizing that he had been exposed by the son's intervention.
Parallel to the investigations, the Carabinieri asked the family to report without delay any other suspicious phone calls and any possible presence of unknown people near the home. The request therefore concerns both new telephone contacts and people noticed near the house.
The family was therefore asked to promptly communicate any further element attributable to the same type of situation. The officers' recommendation is directly connected to the attempt to obtain gold and valuables through a false emergency and a request made in the name of the Arma dei Carabinieri.
In Porlezza, the woman did not hand over her valuables. The failure to hand over the goods was made possible by the son's return while she was still on the phone and by his prompt reaction: he realized that something was not right, intervened in the conversation, and then reported what had happened to 112. The patrol of the Compagnia di Menaggio was thus able to begin investigating the attempted scam.

## TL;DR - Construction work scheduled for mid-December on the Albate-Molteno line - Como-Lecco traffic suspended at least until June 2029 - Estimated investment for the project: approximately 170 million euros - Another 44 million is still needed for Molteno-Lecco
## Key facts - Intervention → electrification of the Albate-Molteno line - Construction work → start in mid-December - Suspension → Como-Lecco until at least June 2029 - Investment → approximately 170 million euros - Expected outcome → 34 and 68 services; TILO to Switzerland as far as Lecco
Construction work on the electrification of the railway line between Albate and Molteno is scheduled to begin in mid-December. The project will be discussed on Friday, October 9, at Lariofiere, during the meeting of the Competitiveness Roundtable. The start of the work was confirmed by senior officials of Rete Ferroviaria Italiana at a hearing of the Regional Council.
For those who use the connection between Como and Lecco, the consequence already indicated is a total suspension of rail traffic until at least June 2029. Details of the replacement bus services remain to be defined. The source therefore does not provide timetables, stops or alternative routes to be used during the closure.
### A project divided into two lots
The project strategy aims to avoid work on road overpasses and underpasses, so as not to affect local traffic. The construction areas will be located near major roads. For the second lot, between Molteno and Lecco, the technical-economic feasibility study has been completed and the environmental impact assessment procedure has been initiated with the Ministry. An electrical substation is also planned in the La Piccola area of Lecco.
The total estimated investment for the project is approximately 170 million euros. The Regional Department for Infrastructure intends to propose that the second section be funded by the Ministry under the new program contract with RFI. Completion of the Molteno-Lecco section will require approximately two years and four months of construction work, but 44 million still need to be secured and the authorization process completed first.
The final plan provides for more services and the definitive abandonment of diesel-powered trains: Albate-Molteno would increase from 24 to 34 trains per day, and Molteno-Lecco from 46 to 68. Electrification would also allow TILO services to Switzerland to be extended as far as Lecco and would provide an alternative route for freight trains coming from Swiss territory. Requests to upgrade the stations, put forward by the Chamber of Commerce and reiterated by the Province of Lecco in its environmental comments, remain open. ## For travelers: two very different phases
For a cross-border commuter who uses the rail connection between Como and Lecco or looks to the future extension of trains toward Switzerland, the project has two distinct effects: a long interruption during the works and a broader service after electrification. The source makes it possible to clearly define the first and second outcomes, but not to establish how each day's travel will be organized.

The increase from 24 to 34 and from 46 to 68 does not describe the services available during the suspension: it indicates the announced upgrade for the subsequent phase.
Likewise, the extension of TILO connections toward Switzerland as far as Lecco is presented as an effect of electrification. The source does not indicate an activation date, timetables or stops for this service; it is therefore not possible to turn the announcement into a precise schedule.
For those who work across the border and travel in the affected area, the certain fact is the railway suspension. The replacement service, on the other hand, has not yet been described in detail. The goal of avoiding work on overpasses and underpasses also offers only a limited indication: the design aims to reduce the impact on local roads, but the source does not quantify any road travel times or travel savings.
The benefit for freight trains coming from Switzerland must also be kept separate from passenger service. The alternative route is intended for freight traffic, while the increase in services and the TILO extension concern the rail connections indicated for passengers.

On October 8, 2026, in Bellinzona, mental health at work was placed at the center of a new collaboration between the Department of Health and Social Affairs (DSS) and Forum GSA Ticino. The decision is based on the results of the latest survey by Promozione Salute Svizzera on work-related stress: one third of people in Switzerland feel emotionally exhausted, while in Ticino nearly one apprentice in three reports anxiety disorders.

item.title: Operation Hermes: VAT fraud 450 mln, seizures 11 mln
item.description: Sei misure cautelari e sequestri per circa 11 milioni
item.content:encoded:
## TL;DR - Six precautionary measures and seizures worth approximately 11 million - VAT fraud in electronics and IT - 93 companies in the Italian part of the investigation - Approximately 300 searches in eight European countries
## Key facts - Operation → “Hermes” - Investigation → alleged VAT carousel fraud - Sector → trade in electronic and IT products - Precautionary measures → six people - Seizures → approximately 11 million euros - Invoices deemed false → more than 450 million euros - Period → 2022-2025 - Searches → approximately 300 in eight European countries
The Guardia di Finanza of Varese carried out six personal precautionary measures and seized assets and sums of money worth approximately 11 million euros. The operation, conducted as part of “Hermes”, forms part of an investigation into an alleged criminal association aimed at committing tax fraud, aggravated by its transnational dimension.
At the heart of the investigation is the alleged VAT carousel fraud in the trade of electronic and IT products. The alleged scheme is believed to have developed across several European Union countries; the investigative activities were entrusted to the Economic and Financial Police Unit of Varese, with the cooperation of the Milan Pef Unit.
Coordination is entrusted to the Milan and Palermo offices of the European Public Prosecutor’s Office, known by the acronym EPPO. The judge for preliminary investigations at the Milan Court ordered precautionary measures against six people: two, reportedly domiciled in Rome, were taken to prison; one was placed under house arrest in the province of Bergamo; the other three were subjected to a residence requirement in the provinces of Salerno and Rome.
### The measures and the seizure
A preventive seizure order, also on an equivalent-value basis, was added to the personal measures. The order concerned assets, valuables and financial resources attributable to eight suspects and three companies involved, for a total value of approximately 11 million euros.
The source therefore distinguishes between two aspects of the operation: on the one hand, the personal measures ordered by the Milan judge; on the other, the preventive order concerning assets, valuables and money traceable to the individuals and companies identified. Both measures were carried out as part of the same operation by the Guardia di Finanza of Varese, with the contribution of the Milan Pef Unit and under the coordination of the European Public Prosecutor’s Office.
The allegation described by investigators has a transnational dimension because the alleged VAT mechanism was reconstructed across several European Union countries. The source places the investigation in the electronics and IT trade and indicates the involvement of several European Union states. The measures carried out in Italy include the precautionary measures against individuals and the seizure of assets, valuables and money up to the stated threshold. According to the Guardia di Finanza's reconstruction, 93 companies operating in the provinces of Bergamo, Milan, Rome, Salerno, Como and Brescia are involved in the Italian part of the investigation. Between 2022 and 2025, the total value of the invoices deemed false exceeded 450 million euros. These figures refer to the Italian component of the investigation into the alleged VAT fraud scheme.
### From the Italian part to the European network
The investigation is part of a broader operation, carried out simultaneously in several European countries and coordinated by EPPO's central office in Luxembourg. Overall, approximately 300 searches were carried out in eight European countries: Spain, Malta, Portugal, France, Austria, the Netherlands and Germany, in addition to Italy.
The international dimension concerns not only the number of countries involved. The Guardia di Finanza explains that the alleged mechanism relies on the VAT-exemption regime provided for trade between European Union countries. A fictitious company, called a «shell company» or a «missing trader», is inserted between companies from different countries.
The shell company sources its goods from an EU supplier without VAT being applied to the purchase, then resells the goods to an Italian company, charging VAT at the standard rate. However, the VAT collected would not be paid to the Treasury: the shell company would sell the goods below cost without paying the tax shown on the invoices.
Investigators generally describe these companies as lacking operational structures and employees, often registered in the names of nominees. Their operations would cease after a relatively short period, to be replaced by other companies with similar characteristics.
### Steps in the carousel
The scheme may include additional stages through companies known as «filter» or «buffer» companies. These businesses are inserted into the commercial chain with the aim of making it more difficult to identify the mechanism and the ultimate beneficiaries.
At the final stage of the chain are the «broker» companies, genuinely operating businesses that purchase the products with VAT charged and consequently accrue a credit with the Treasury. The goods can then be placed on the Italian market at prices made artificially competitive by the mechanism or resold abroad, including to the companies from which the first transaction had originated. This is how the so-called «carousel» can restart.
According to investigators, the damage to public finances stems from the VAT shown on the shell companies' invoices: the tax is collected in subsequent commercial transactions, but is not paid to the Treasury. The international coordination of the “Hermes” operation involved the offices of the European Public Prosecutor’s Office in Madrid, Porto, Milan, Palermo, Paris, Graz, Valletta, Bucharest, Rotterdam, Frankfurt and Vilnius. The operation therefore brought together EPPO structures located in several countries, alongside the work carried out in Italy by the Varese Guardia di Finanza and the Milan Pef Unit.
The operation benefited from the support of Europol, law enforcement agencies and tax authorities in the countries concerned. The activities extended to the homes, company premises and offices of natural and legal persons considered, for various reasons, to be linked to the alleged fraudulent scheme. During the action, precautionary measures, searches and seizures were carried out.
For the Italian part, funds held at Swiss banks were also seized. The reference to accounts in Switzerland therefore falls within the asset-related activities carried out as part of the investigation, together with the assets, valuables and money already traced back to the eight suspects and the three companies covered by the preventive seizure order.
### The profile of the investigation
The Guardia di Finanza places the operation within the framework of actions against VAT fraud, tax evasion and economic and financial crime. Investigators explain that phenomena of this kind can undermine free competition and penalize businesses that operate in compliance with the rules.
The same account retains the alleged nature of the charges. The persons involved were subject to the measures as part of the investigation, while responsibility must be definitively established in court. This is the step indicated by the source for the judicial follow-up of the case.
The operation thus brings together an Italian investigative component, with operating companies identified in various provinces, and activity coordinated at European level. The searches, seizures and measures carried out in the various countries were conducted as part of the same operation against the alleged carousel VAT fraud scheme.

## TL;DR - Varese loses its cup debut in Murcia - Kastritis promotes defensive intensity - McDowell and Della Valle are significant absences - Librizzi: the team can do much better
## Key facts - Debut → Champions League - Place → Murcia - Teams → Pallacanestro Varese and UCAM Murcia - Coaches → Ioannis Kastritis and Sito Alonso - Absences → McDowell and Della Valle - Playmaker → Matteo Librizzi - Next match → a new match in three days
### The coach's reading Murcia gave Pallacanestro Varese a first cup match to forget. The red and white team was overwhelmed by UCAM Murcia, while coach Ioannis Kastritis chose to start with compliments to his opponents, recognizing coach Alonso and the Murcia team for a great performance.
However, in the results of the Varese match, Kastritis saved the work done in the defensive half of the pitch. According to the coach, the players gave their all, especially in the defensive phase, with many very aggressive elements ready to fight for every ball. The evaluation concerns the attitude shown during the match, even if it does not erase the debut defeat.
The coach described Varese as a group of players who work hard every day. The team is new and still has to build its mechanisms, growing possession after possession. The construction of the group is therefore indicated as a path that is still open, to be developed through daily work and the experience accumulated in matches.
Kastritis recognized the weight of the absences of McDowell and Della Valle, defined as "a significant factor". At the same time, he reiterated that Varese Basketball does not want and will not make excuses. The coach's position is clear: training difficulties and absences are part of the situation, but must not become a justification for the performance offered.
Even criticism, according to Kastritis, is normal and right at this moment. However, they must have a concrete utility and be productive, so as to push the team out of their comfort zone. The coach accompanied this request with a declaration of full confidence in each of his players, keeping the focus of the discussion on the group and the work to be completed. ### The reactions after the race Matteo Librizzi indicated the analysis of errors as the first step after the defeat in Murcia. The Varese basketball point guard explained that the team must fully understand what didn't work, because the approach to the first match of the tournament was not the desired one. His assessment therefore concerns the start of the match and the way in which the group approached their debut in the Champions League.
Librizzi did not hide his self-criticism, but linked the analysis to the possibility of reacting already in the next matches. The team, he said, is "perfectly aware that it can do much better." The goal indicated by the point guard is to work to identify errors and transform that reading into an immediate improvement in subsequent games.
On the UCAM Murcia side, Sito Alonso described a positive evening for the team's first home victory in the Champions League. The coach attributed the result to the intensity with which Murcia approached the match and the desire to limit the main offensive points of reference of the Varese team. The preparation for the match therefore focused on the attacking solutions considered most important for Varese.
Alonso also highlighted the return to the pitch of Kaiser Gates, who was absent due to a very long and serious injury. The coach chose to give him space at the start of the match to allow him to find his rhythm. The response from a physical point of view was considered positive, so much so that Alonso defined recovery as a fundamental element for Murcia.
The UCAM coach recalled that he knew Varese well and that the Italian team lacked high-level players. However, he specified that Murcia also had to deal with the absence of key elements. The reading of the opponents therefore did not stop at the red and white difficulties, but also considered the situation of the Spanish team.
For Alonso, in the Champions League the points difference has a decisive impact on the group. Hence the request to maintain constant defensive aggression for the entire 40 minutes, without drops. His explanation distinguishes two behaviors: when Murcia is not aggressive it becomes vulnerable; when he manages to impose his physicality, he can compete with anyone. ### The work indicated by Kastritis The message addressed to Varese Basketball already looks to the continuation of the season. Kastritis defined the period the team went through as difficult, but added that in the future it could be considered extremely valuable for the growth of the group. The current difficulty is therefore inserted into a broader path, without separating it from the work necessary to improve.
The condition indicated by the coach is to all remain united and solid. The work must continue every day, with a double objective: improving individual players and helping the team as a whole grow. Kastritis did not separate the two dimensions, because in his message individual and collective development proceed together.
The coach also rejected the idea of ​​immediate perfection. Expecting to already be perfect in October, he explained, would be unrealistic. The defeat doesn't make him happy, but his assessment looks at the ability to face difficulties by remaining united and building the path day after day.
The next match is already indicated shortly: a new match awaits Varese in three days. Kastritis linked this commitment to the need to remain united and continue pushing, without interrupting the work started. The calendar therefore offers the team an immediate opportunity to apply what emerged from the words of the coach and point guard.
### A season of ups and downs Kastritis recalled that the story of a season is made up of high and low moments. The point, in his perspective, is not to ignore the negative phase or declare oneself satisfied after a defeat. It's about facing difficulties with unity, maintaining faith in the players and continuing to build the path.
The follow-up indicated to Pallacanestro Varese therefore remains linked to three recurring words in the coach's statements: unity, work and growth. The match in Murcia opened a difficult moment, but the response required does not involve excuses or promises. It goes from daily work, from the analysis of errors and from the ability to remain solid in view of the next commitment.

item.description: La Pro Patria batte il Varese 5-2 al Franco Ossola.
item.content:encoded:
## TL;DR - Pro Patria beats Varese 5-2 at the Franco Ossola. - Maistrello, Mapelli and Bonaidi make it 3-0. - Gallotti and Castellucchio bring Varese back to 2-3. - In the round of 32, Pro will face Leon.
## Key facts - → Pro Patria Result 5, Varese 2 - → Franco Ossola Stadium, Masnago - Serie D Italian → Cup Competition - Next round → Sixteenth against Leon - Opening hours → Wednesday at 3pm - Last Derby → 14 March 2010
Varese tried, but Pro Patria did not forgive Franco Ossola. The tigers won 5-2 in Masnago, winning the passage to the sixteenth round of the Italian Cup Series D, where they will face Leon. The race produced many nets, but also an obvious difference in the quality of the roses and in the concreteness under the goal.
### The advantage built in the first half
The first half showed two distinct attitudes. Varese tried to take advantage of the restarts and built some interesting plots, while Pro Patria appeared more maneuvering. To see the first conclusion it was necessary to wait for the 12': Favale engaged Gnonto with a left-handed man from outside, rejected in a dive by the tigrotto goalkeeper. The Pro responded with a head shot of Maistrello finished over the crossbar and with a crossbar of Nanni neutralized on the ground by Mangano.
At 20' the red-whites had the sharpest opportunity of the first part. Del Señor hit a nice corner, Sovogui stretched the head ball and Dodaj, stationed in the goal area, sent a high breath. Four minutes later De Ponti, in an attempt to get ahead of Maistrello on a Bonaidi cross, risked the own goal. From the next action, on the developments of the corner, Maistrello could not turn Nanni's cross towards the door.
The striker came back in 26', unlocking the challenge with a left-handed man of first intention who beat Mangano. The double came in the 31st minute, when Mapelli found the detour under goal, celebrating the former's classic goal. The double disadvantage did not stop Varese, who continued to look for the play in the last meters. At 42' Cogliati twisted the left-handed man; shortly after Favale, from a good position, did not frame the door with his right. In the recovery Mapelli and then Cannistrà rejected the off-white initiatives, sending the teams to the interval with the Pro Patria ahead 2-0. ## The second half and the derby context
The second half quickly changed the score. Varese started with greater initiative and came close to risking an own goal when Cannistrà misplaced a pass to Gnonto. The goalkeeper came out, and the ball went out for a corner after grazing the post. The corner led to another dangerous situation, with the ball bouncing in the area, but once again the red-and-whites lacked the decisive finish.
### From 3-0 to 3-2
Pro Patria reacted in the most effective way possible. On the counterattack, Bonaidi beat Mangano with a shot from the heart of the area, putting the Tigrotti 3-0 up. Varese did not give up and, at 10' in the second half, coach Ciceri brought on Castellucchio for Tronci and Gallotti for Sovogui.
The substitution paid off immediately. Gallotti scored with the first ball he touched: Gnonto misplaced a pass, Favale intercepted it and set up the young forward, who scored with a diagonal left-footed shot. The goal narrowed the gap and put the red-and-whites back in the match. Varese continued to push; Castellucchio then scored the temporary 2-3 with a wayward cross, reopening the contest even further.
The teams had lined up in different formations. Varese had opted for a 4-3-3, with Del Signore as the playmaker alongside Malinverno and Piantoni, while Favale, Sovogui and Cogliati played up front. Zironelli responded with a 3-4-3, with Nanni, Maistrello and Siega leading the attack. The red-and-white comeback highlighted Pro Patria's lapse in concentration after the third goal, but Varese's efforts fell short of completing the comeback.
### A derby returning after sixteen years
The match in Masnago also marked the derby's return after sixteen years. The last meeting had been on 14 March 2010, when Sannino's team had beaten the blue-and-whites coached by the late Vincenzo Cosco 3-1. Varese would then be promoted to Serie B at the end of the season, while Pro Patria would end the campaign with a bitter relegation. More than 6000 days have passed since then, marked by the ups and downs of the two clubs, with promotions and bankruptcies along the way.
The historic occasion, however, did not have a fitting setting. The kickoff scheduled for 15:00 on Wednesday, during working hours, and the inability to buy tickets in person left the Franco Ossola almost empty: there were about one hundred fans in the grandstand, while a dozen occupied the away section. The source describes the ticket-sales policy as in need of review and observes that a match between two historic rivals was reduced to a show for a select few. ## What happens after 5-2
### The ending that set the result
After Varese's 2-3, the match remained open until stoppage time, but the red-and-white push did not come to fruition. Late on, Pro Patria first extended its lead with Gianola's penalty, awarded for De Ponti's hold on Frattini. Shortly afterward, Frattini himself put the match to bed: he stole the ball from De Ponti and scored the goal that made it 5-2, the final score.
The double incident completed a match in which Pro Patria knew how to strike at decisive moments. Varese had reopened the game after trailing by three goals, but failed to turn the comeback into a positive result. For the tigrotti, on the other hand, the victory means progressing to the next round of the Coppa Italia di Serie D.
### The Coppa makes way for the league
With the Coppa Italia interlude over, Pro Patria will face Leon in the round of 32. The match played at Franco Ossola was the round-of-64 tie and represented the first knockout fixture before the two teams' league double-header. The next Coppa stage is therefore already set, although the source does not indicate the date of the match.
For Varese, the return to league action will once again be at Franco Ossola, where Oltrepò will arrive. The red-and-white team will have to try to turn the page after the defeat in Crema and the one suffered against Pro Patria. The next home fixture will thus mark the transition from the knockout competition to the need to get the league campaign back on track.
Pro Patria, meanwhile, will be at the Speroni against Sant'Angelo. The stated objective is to try to close the gap on Pistoiese, who on the same day showed that they are not unbeatable by losing at home to Sestri Levante. Pistoiese's result therefore opens up a different outlook for the tigrotti's campaign, as they are called to continue the league after advancing in the Coppa.
The schedule therefore sends both teams toward a new home fixture, but with different opponents and objectives: Varese will host Oltrepò to respond to its last two defeats, while Pro Patria will welcome Sant'Angelo with an eye on the gap to Pistoiese. ## TL;DR - Two cultural events in Varese on 9 and 11 October - Dante at the center of Friday's meeting at 5:30 pm - Three unpublished stories by Carlo Linati on Sunday at 5:00 pm
